authorization.basis: Explicit human steer allows fewer swimsuit photos; exact10 independent safe unused originals, identity/quality/no-logo/no-reuse gates remain.

theme_rationale: A short city break with cafe, bookshop, rainy walk, greenhouse, dinner and one warm-coast bikini scene. The existing varied originals support a fashion/travel issue with one swimsuit photo.
season_context: Warm coast/pool scenes are a warm-location trip in a November issue, not ordinary cold-weather outdoor swimming.

schema_notes.garment_kind: Requested internal handoff classification only. Integrate existing validator fields; do not invent a new public enum.
schema_notes.final_jpeg_review: Original PNG QA is complete; converted JPEG/adoption/caption QA remains pending.

excluded: Older bedroom lace-lingerie image is not selected.
composition_notes: Dinner/cheek-on-hand views recur but are separated by wider and outdoor scenes. Selected originals are independent byte/pixel files; no newspaper reuse found.
